createcaes.tooltip.air_engine.title: Air Engine
createcaes.tooltip.pressure_vessel.title: Pressure Vessel
block.createcaes.air_engine.tooltip.summ: Stores a network's _spare power_ as compressed air, and _gives it back_ when the network runs short. Bolts onto a _Pressure Vessel_ and drives a _shaft_ from the opposite side.
block.createcaes.air_engine.tooltip.beha: Runs as a _compressor_, drawing surplus _Stress_ and filling the vessel with _Compressed Air_.

Acts as a _motor_ instead, spending stored air to supply the _Stress_ that is missing. The shaft keeps turning the _same way_ and at the _same speed_ it already was. Output depends on the _size of the vessel_, as a Steam Engine's depends on its boiler.
block.createcaes.pressure_vessel.tooltip: Holds _Compressed Air_ for an _Air Engine_. Stack them up to _3x3_ wide to form a larger vessel.
When Placed Against a Wider Vessel
Places an _entire layer_ at once. _Sneak_ to place a single block.
createcaes.tooltip.air_engine.idle.netwo: Network is already running on stored air
Network is running on stored power
createcaes.ponder.air_engine.header: Storing surplus power as compressed air
createcaes.ponder.air_engine.text_1: Pressure Vessels hold Compressed Air. Stack them up to 3x3 wide, as you would a Fluid Tank
createcaes.ponder.air_engine.text_2: An Air Engine bolts onto the vessel and drives a shaft from the opposite side
createcaes.ponder.air_engine.text_3: While the network has capacity to spare, the engine draws it and fills the vessel
createcaes.ponder.air_engine.text_4: When the network can no longer carry its own load, the same engine becomes a motor
createcaes.ponder.air_engine.text_5: It spends stored air to supply the missing capacity, turning the shaft the same way and at the same speed it already was
createcaes.ponder.air_engine.text_6: A bigger vessel means more stress supplied and longer to supply it, the way a bigger boiler does for a Steam Engine
